newsitem.title: USA: US spot jet diffs slip lower, NYMEX declines.
newsitem.headline: US spot jet diffs slip lower, NYMEX declines.

text.p: U.S. spot jet fuel prices spiraled lower Tuesday as both differentials and NYMEX prices weakened.
"It's still a buyers market. It's not hard to pick up barrels when you need to," one trader said.

U.S. Gulf 54-grade jet fuel for the first cycle on the Colonial Pipeline changed hands at 2.85 cents under the screen, with bids slipping back to 3.0 cents under late in the day, down about 0.75 cents from Monday.
New York Harbor 54-grade for prompt delivery traded at 1.60 cents, but slipped off that level by the NYMEX close.
-- Matt Daily, New York Energy Desk +1 212 859 1626
